exact_integer_model.unit: S/M/C integer scale 1/10000 of numeric 分, J displayed as 1 degree plus six-decimal fractional degree
exact_integer_model.step: C[n+1]=C[n]+M[n]; M[n+1]=M[n]-S[n]; S[n+1]=S[n]+186, where this is a CONDITIONAL four-place step model, NOT a historically attested rounding instruction
exact_integer_model.degree: J[n]=1+floor(M_x10000[n]/100)/1,000,000; integer floor is on positive M_x10000; equivalent to displaying 1+M[n]/10000 to six decimal degree places by truncation
exact_integer_model.non_identifiability_proof: For δ=0.018600 or 0.018625 under the 13QO conditional per-step Q4 floor or half-up, S[n] and M[n] are identical by induction. If C[n+1]=C[n]+M[n] and J[n]=trunc6(1+M[n]/10000), then C[n] and J[n] are also identical for every n. The longer-looking six-decimal J output is just scale conversion of four-decimal M; it does not supply independent 5th/6th decimal places in the source short-lane increment.
limits: Observed received C/J matching a derived model is NOT original-source proof of the ancient construction, especially before source-native C/J heading/column glyph collation.
Conditional equivalence does NOT hold if the original source used a nonrecurrent high-precision intermediate, independent sexagesimal unit or independently generated J/C values.
Original source-specific 少/微 radix, carry, epoch and field identities remain OPEN.

adjudication.positive: Current six original-S/M anchors and corresponding official received C/J entries are exactly compatible with one deterministic derived four-column model; apparent higher printed precision in received J is not an independent discriminator under that model.
